description: Marion, IA – Ashley Hinson launched a new ad for the general election today, “Food Fight.” The ad is set to air on broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms across Iowa. [Watch Here] “Washington is one never-ending food fight. Both sides throwing out attacks. Both sides creating one heck of a mess. It’s funny in a commercial, but not in Washington. To get stuff done out there, you got to bring folks together. That’s how we expanded mental healthcare for veterans and got rural moms the maternal care they deserve. If my boys can get along sometimes, so can Washington.” No matter who is in office or who holds the majority, Ashley has been an effective, bipartisan leader for Iowans: ###

title: Hinson Releases New Ad: "Food Fight" - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
